Peaceful. The name of “Eden” is endearing. It provides a tranquil introduction, and the color palette of the app reinforces the calmness. It’s intuitive, and it works with small habits and works its way up. The aspect that I love the most is that for those who don’t care about taking care of themselves, but they love to take care of other people, Eden is the gentle union of bridging that together. By taking care of the flower, the user of Eden must take care of himself. It’s sweet, and vulnerable, and something that needs protecting to flourish. The flower is precious to me, so I must be aware of what my needs for growth are as well. ALSO: not sponsored. 😄
